events.name: Festival City Farmers Market
events.note: Saturday market downtown; becomes the Christmas Market from Nov 28.
events.description: Downtown Cedar City's Saturday market. It becomes the Festival City Christmas Market from Nov 28.

events.name: Iron Mission Days & Old Town Market
events.note: Living-history demos and an old-town market.
events.description: Living-history demonstrations and an Old Town Market at Frontier Homestead State Park.

events.name: Cedar City's 175th Birthday – Lobby Activities
events.note: Free lobby activities before the 7:30pm Birthday Spectacular.
events.description: Free lobby activities at the Heritage Theater celebrating Cedar City's 175th birthday, before the evening's Birthday Spectacular.

events.name: Downtown Holiday Lighting Ceremony
events.description: Cedar City's holiday celebration in the historic downtown, with the lighting and fireworks at 6pm. Free admission.

events.name: Festival City Christmas Market
events.note: Thursdays–Saturdays: produce, baked goods, handmade gifts.
events.description: A free holiday market at the Festival City Farmers Market site, held Thursdays to Saturdays through Dec 19. Local vendors sell produce, baked goods and handmade items.

events.name: Holiday Tree Jubilee
events.description: Cedar City's Holiday Tree Jubilee, open Nov 28 and Nov 30–Dec 1.

events.name: SUMA Exhibition: Tooveep (The Land)
events.place: Southern Utah Museum of Art, 13 S 300 W
events.description: A Southern Utah Museum of Art exhibition, part of Iron County's America 250 celebration, running through March 6.

events.name: Storytime Tuesday at Frontier Homestead
events.place: Frontier Homestead State Park Museum, 635 N Main St
events.description: A children's story time every Tuesday at Frontier Homestead State Park Museum.

events.name: Fee-Free Day at Bryce Canyon (Veterans Day)
events.description: Bryce Canyon waives its entrance fee for Veterans Day. In 2026, fee-free days apply to U.S. citizens and residents.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Full Moon Hike
events.place: Bryce Canyon National Park (meeting spot varies)
events.note: Free ranger hike; reserve on Recreation.gov (released 14 and 5 days ahead).
events.description: A ranger's-choice full moon hike at sunset that may stay on the rim or descend steep, rocky trails into the canyon. Reservations open on Recreation.gov in two phases, 14 and 5 days in advance.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Full Moon Hike (December)
events.place: Bryce Canyon National Park (meeting spot varies)
events.note: Free ranger hike; reserve on Recreation.gov.
events.description: December's ranger-led full moon hike at Bryce Canyon, offered at sunset as weather permits. Tickets release on Recreation.gov 14 and 5 days in advance.
